column1: The Abyssal Maw lurks in the deepest trenches and swallows anything that strays into its light.
column2: 深渊巨口潜伏在最深的海沟, 吞噬一切误入其光芒的东西.

column1: Aluminum is light, strong and the most common metal in the earth's crust.
column2: 铝轻巧而坚固, 也是地壳中最常见的金属.

column1: Ancient debris survives lava and fire, and refines into netherite.
column2: 远古残骸不惧熔岩与火焰, 可精炼成下界合金.

column1: Each of the ten guardians embodies one magical affinity, and each guards a relic of it.
column2: 十位守护者各自代表一种魔法亲和, 并守护着对应的遗物.

column1: Boron soaks up neutrons, so reactors use it to keep their fuel in check.
column2: 硼能吸收中子, 因此反应堆用它控制燃料反应.

column1: Angry Zombies keep enough of their brains to hold a grudge.
column2: 愤怒僵尸还保留着足够的脑子来记仇.

column1: Celestine shards carry signals through Nodeworks networks.
column2: 天青石碎片能在 Nodeworks 网络中传递信号.

column1: Chimerite shifts its color with the light, and mages prize it for that changeability.
column2: 奇美拉宝石随光线变幻色彩, 法师们格外珍视这种变化.

column1: Chromium gives stainless steel its shine and its resistance to rust.
column2: 铬赋予不锈钢光泽与耐锈能力.

column1: Cinnabar is the ore of quicksilver, the alchemist's favorite metal.
column2: 朱砂是汞的矿石, 而汞深受炼金术士喜爱.

column1: Coal is ancient plant matter pressed into fuel over millions of years.
column2: 煤由远古植物残骸历经数百万年压实而成.

column1: Copper carries current better than almost any other common metal.
column2: 铜的导电性能胜过几乎所有其他常见金属.

column1: A cyclops herds sheep in its cave, and it does not take kindly to visitors.
column2: 独眼巨人在洞穴中放牧羊群, 对访客可不怎么友好.

column1: Dark Gems hum with a faint, unsettling energy that EvilCraft feeds on.
column2: 暗黑宝石蕴含着微弱而令人不安的能量, 邪恶工艺正以此为源.

column1: A demon only answers a witch's summons, and it rarely leaves willingly.
column2: 恶魔只回应女巫的召唤, 而且很少愿意自行离开.

column1: Diamond is pure carbon, crushed into the hardest natural material there is.
column2: 钻石由纯碳受压而成, 是最坚硬的天然材料.

column1: Dimensional shards hold a sliver of space folded in on itself.
column2: 维度碎片中封存着一小片自我折叠的空间.

column1: Emeralds are the coin villagers trust above all others.
column2: 绿宝石是村民最信赖的货币.

column1: Fire dragons nest in scorched caves and roosts, and their blood and hearts are the heart of dragonsteel forging.
column2: 火龙栖息于焦灼的洞穴与巢穴, 它们的血与心脏是锻造龙钢的关键.

column1: Gold never rusts or tarnishes, which is why it has been prized for thousands of years.
column2: 黄金不会生锈或失去光泽, 因而数千年来一直备受珍视.

column1: Cut one head off a hydra and two more grow back, unless you burn the stump.
column2: 砍下九头蛇的一颗头, 就会再长出两颗, 除非你烧灼断口.

column1: Ice dragons freeze everything they breathe on, and they guard the coldest peaks of the world.
column2: 冰龙的吐息冻结万物, 它们守卫着世界最寒冷的山巅.

column1: Iesnium is a pale metal from the Nether that Occultism's spirits value.
column2: 艾瑟金属是一种来自下界的浅色金属, 深受神秘学灵体珍视.

column1: Inferium is the first step on Mystical Agriculture's long road to growing resources.
column2: 下级精华是神秘农业资源种植漫漫长路的第一步.

column1: Iridium is one of the densest and most corrosion-resistant elements known.
column2: 铱是已知密度最大, 最耐腐蚀的元素之一.

column1: Iron is the backbone of nearly every machine, rail and tool you will ever build.
column2: 铁是你建造的几乎所有机器, 铁轨与工具的基础.

column1: Lapis lazuli was once ground into the blue pigment painters valued above gold.
column2: 青金石曾被磨成蓝色颜料, 在画家眼中比黄金更珍贵.

column1: Lead is dense enough to stop radiation, which makes it a reactor builder's friend.
column2: 铅的高密度能阻挡辐射, 是反应堆建造者的好帮手.

column1: Lightning dragons call storms down on their enemies and nest in the high badlands.
column2: 电龙召唤风暴打击敌人, 在高耸的恶地筑巢.

column1: Lunar Parasites burrow into anything that lands on the Moon, villagers included.
column2: 月球寄生虫会钻进所有登陆月球的生物体内, 村民也不例外.

column1: A Mutant Creeper charges up and leaps before it blows, and it can survive its own blast.
column2: 突变苦力怕会在引爆前蓄力跃起, 并能从自己的爆炸中存活.

column1: A Mutant Enderman hurls blocks with its four arms and teleports its prey around.
column2: 突变末影人用四条手臂投掷方块, 并将猎物传送来传送去.

column1: A Mutant Skeleton's bones are large enough to wear as armor.
column2: 突变骷髅的骨头大到可以做成盔甲穿戴.

column1: A Mutant Zombie slams the ground hard enough to throw you off your feet.
column2: 突变僵尸猛砸地面, 力量足以将你掀翻.

column1: Nether quartz grows in the Nether's rock and is the start of most electronics.
column2: 下界石英生长在下界岩层中, 是大多数电子元件的基础.

column1: Nickel keeps steel from rusting and gives superalloys their strength under heat.
column2: 镍使钢耐锈, 并赋予高温合金耐热强度.

column1: Niobium turns superconducting when cold, and LTX Industries builds on that.
column2: 铌在低温下会成为超导体, LTX工业正利用了这一特性.

column1: Piglin Brutes guard bastion treasure and cannot be bribed with gold.
column2: 猪灵蛮兵守卫堡垒宝藏, 无法用黄金收买.

column1: Pillagers raid villages for emeralds, and the vexes their allies summon fight alongside them.
column2: 掠夺者为绿宝石袭击村庄, 盟友召唤的恼鬼也会协同作战.

column1: Platinum resists nearly every acid and tarnish, making it a coveted catalyst metal.
column2: 铂几乎能抵抗所有酸蚀与氧化, 因而是备受青睐的催化金属.

column1: Prosperity shards are what turn a plain seed into a magical one.
column2: 繁荣碎片能让普通种子蜕变为魔法种子.

column1: Ravagers lead the charge in a raid and flatten crops in their path.
column2: 劫掠兽在袭击中率先冲锋, 踩平沿途的作物.

column1: Redstone dust carries a signal through any circuit you can dream up.
column2: 红石粉能在你构想的各种电路中传递信号.

column1: Sapphires form deep in cold mountains, the same places ice dragons like to nest.
column2: 蓝宝石形成于寒冷山脉深处, 冰龙也喜欢在那里筑巢.

column1: Sea serpents roam the open ocean and can capsize a boat with one sweep of their tail.
column2: 海蟒游荡于远洋, 一记扫尾就能掀翻船只.

column1: Silver conducts heat and electricity better than any other metal.
column2: 银的导热和导电性能胜过所有其他金属.

column1: The Star Crawler Mother guards her brood deep under the lunar surface.
column2: 星行者母体在月表深处守护着自己的幼群.

column1: Sunstone stores the heat of the Nether and gives it back to fire spells.
column2: 日长石储存下界的热量, 再将其释放给火焰法术.

column1: The Thunder King commands the storm itself, and his royal armor still crackles with it.
column2: 雷霆之王驾驭风暴, 他的王者铠甲仍闪烁着雷电.

column1: Tin alloys readily with copper to make bronze, one of the oldest worked metals.
column2: 锡易与铜熔合为青铜, 这是人类最早加工的金属之一.

column1: Titanium is as strong as steel at nearly half the weight.
column2: 钛的强度与钢相当, 重量却只有约一半.

column1: Topaz is the stone Ars Magica casters lean on for their earliest spells.
column2: 黄玉是魔法艺术施法者学习早期法术时依赖的宝石.

column1: Trolls turn to stone in sunlight, so they only come out to hunt at night.
column2: 巨魔在阳光下会化为石头, 因此只在夜间外出狩猎.

column1: Uraninite is the ore uranium is refined from, and it is faintly radioactive.
column2: 晶质铀矿可用于提炼铀, 并具有微弱放射性.

column1: Uranium packs more energy into a single ingot than a mountain of coal.
column2: 一块铀锭蕴含的能量胜过堆积如山的煤炭.

column1: Vinteum dust is the raw stuff of magical energy in Ars Magica.
column2: 温特姆粉是魔法艺术中魔法能量的原料.

column1: Blue xychorium crystals store energy in their lattice, the basis of XyCraft's machines.
column2: 蓝色Xy晶晶体在晶格中储存能量, 是 XyCraft 机器的基础.

column1: Dark xychorium crystals store energy in their lattice, the basis of XyCraft's machines.
column2: 黑色Xy晶晶体在晶格中储存能量, 是 XyCraft 机器的基础.

column1: Green xychorium crystals store energy in their lattice, the basis of XyCraft's machines.
column2: 绿色Xy晶晶体在晶格中储存能量, 是 XyCraft 机器的基础.

column1: Light xychorium crystals store energy in their lattice, the basis of XyCraft's machines.
column2: 浅色Xy晶晶体在晶格中储存能量, 是 XyCraft 机器的基础.

column1: Red xychorium crystals store energy in their lattice, the basis of XyCraft's machines.
column2: 红色Xy晶晶体在晶格中储存能量, 是 XyCraft 机器的基础.
